claim_scope: Direct packed AR graph model-step row scaling on one host. Diagnostic anchor for the external-report requalification in docs/QWEN38-STRIX-HALO-EXTERNAL-SURVEY.md. Not a retained performance claim, not HTTP serving goodput, and not the speculative verify frontier path.
decision: Establish the local weight-amortization curve so external Strix Halo AR/MTP reports can be normalized onto implied memory bandwidth. Rows 1-4 amortize weights nearly perfectly (1.000 -> 1.126 weight sweeps per step); rows 4-8 cost +88% wall for 2x rows (2.122 sweeps). R=1 gives 198.4 GB/s streamed, 90% of the 220 GB/s practical roof and 78% of the 256 GB/s theoretical peak.
